{"id":1497642763,"question_id":680,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 6 months","timestamp":1736011466,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"5 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1497642763/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Valid Palindrome II","memory":"27.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool checkPalindrome(string s , int i ,int j){\n        while(i<=j){\n            if(s[i] != s[j])\n            {\n                return false;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                i++;\n                j--;\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n    bool validPalindrome(string s) {\n        int i=0;\n        int j=s.length()-1;\n        while(i<=j){\n            if(s[i] == s[j])\n            {\n                i++;\n                j--;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                bool ideletion = checkPalindrome(s , i+1 ,j);\n                bool jdeletion = checkPalindrome(s , i , j-1);\n\n                return  ideletion || jdeletion ;  \n            }\n        }\n        return true ;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"valid-palindrome-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":117}
